description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different multilingual BERT models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) on various linguistic features (case, gender, tag, number) across different languages. The vertical axis represents the effect, measured in a numerical scale, while the horizontal axis categorizes the linguistic features. Each bar represents the effect of a model on a specific feature, with varying heights indicating the magnitude of the effect. The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the different models. The chart includes error bars, suggesting variability or confidence intervals around the effect estimates. The x-axis is sorted by the linguistic features, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
